data.body:
[P2] Allow rejected SDK calls to settle without an exit

This counts `REJECTED` checkpoint and poll calls as outstanding until an exit appears. The documented contract and `validate_retirement_evidence()` explicitly permit a rejected call without an exit when a matching rejected SDK request corroborates it; `build_evidence()` generates that matching request. Such a conforming stream therefore remains pending, receives an `UNKNOWN` invocation settlement, and cannot release its target. Apply the validator's rejected-call exemption here and add a builder regression without a corresponding exit.
